test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Comittee"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here let's learn the correct spelling:

__
 
• **Committee - ** a body of persons delegated to consider, investigate, take action on, or report on some matter

 
 
• ***Eg. ***An advisory* committee *was established.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** We will learn some other new word meanings:

 
• **Hegemony -** leadership or dominance, especially by one state or social group over others.

 
 
• ***Eg. ***Germany was united under Prussian* hegemony* after 1871.
 
 
 
• **Nebulous -** in the form of a cloud or haze; hazy.
 
 
• ***Eg. ***A giant *nebulous *glow
 
 
 
• **Elephantine - **of, resembling, or characteristic of an elephant or elephants, especially in being large, clumsy, or awkward.
 
 
• ***Eg. ***There was an *elephantine* thud from the bathroom
